floorPolicy: Body, belly, tail and resting cheek lie on ONE flat support plane. ONLY paws can overhang below taskbar/window lip. Physically compress/bunch fur; never slice/crop it. Side-sleep support plane is anchored at resting cheek.

curled.supportMethod: Median opaque bottom contour over body/tail region; verify visually before runtime
